central_conflict.text: The father's death was not a heart attack but poisoning; Rawat and Kabir both hide their roles in covering it up.

stakes.text: The hotel's land records, Isha's inheritance, Nikhil's safety, and the truth about her father's death are all at risk.

summary.text: Isha returns to the Pinecrest Hotel after ten years, seeking answers about her father's death. She discovers a note warning her not to trust K, and learns the hotel's staff and family are hiding secrets. Inspector Rawat, her father's friend, is revealed to have poisoned him with ginger tea. The truth emerges when Isha finds a will naming Zoya as her sister, leaving open whether Zoya is truly her father's daughter.

items.one_line_summary: Isha returns to the Pinecrest Hotel, confronts her family over her father's death, and discovers a hidden note warning her not to trust anyone at the hotel.
items.ending_rationale: The ending establishes a key warning but lacks a direct action or threat to compel viewer engagement.

items.one_line_summary: Isha confronts lies about her father's death, discovers a post-mortem was avoided, and learns the hotel's sale is being pushed to protect debts.
items.ending_rationale: The ending closes the post-mortem thread but doesn't introduce a new conflict or character threat, making it less compelling.

items.one_line_summary: Isha confronts Kabir about deleted footage, learns Nikhil owes money, and discovers Zoya is her father's secret daughter.
items.ending_rationale: The ending reveals a deep family secret, creating emotional stakes and a personal connection that pulls viewers forward.

items.one_line_summary: Isha discovers her father's land records were hidden, and a secret connection between Zoya and her father emerges.
items.ending_rationale: The revelation of Zoya as the daughter adds emotional depth and a personal stake, pulling viewers into the next episode.

items.one_line_summary: Kabir confesses to hiding footage of Inspector Rawat visiting Dad's room, revealing a hidden truth about the murder.
items.ending_rationale: The revelation of Rawat's visit is strong, but the emotional closure is thin and underdeveloped.

items.one_line_summary: Isha discovers her brother is being held hostage and a threat is made to force her to sign the sale papers.
items.ending_rationale: The ending creates immediate stakes and a personal threat, pulling viewers into the next episode with urgency.

items.one_line_summary: Isha discovers Rawat was involved in her father's death, and Nikhil reveals he saw Rawat in the footage from the night of the murder.
items.ending_rationale: The revelation that Rawat is the killer, confirmed by voice and motive, creates a sharp reversal that recontextualizes the entire story.

items.one_line_summary: Isha and family uncover Rawat's role in father's death, reveal Zoya as daughter, and find hidden will.
items.ending_rationale: The revelation of Zoya as daughter and the will create emotional depth and a strong narrative pivot that hooks viewers.

items.one_line_summary: Isha and team recover original land records from a burning archive, revealing Dad's true legacy and hidden family truth.
items.ending_rationale: The fire and land records reveal truth, but the emotional climax is delayed until the next episode.

items.one_line_summary: Isha discovers her father's will reveals Zoya as his daughter, exposing a hidden family truth and ending the conspiracy.
items.ending_rationale: The revelation of Zoya as the daughter recontextualizes the entire story, creating emotional depth and a strong narrative pivot that pulls viewers forward.

emotion.narrative: The story begins with a quiet trust in homecoming (L1-L13), then fractures into fear and suspicion as family secrets emerge (L14-L35). As Isha uncovers lies and threats, fear dominates (L36-L146), peaking when Nikhil is captured and the truth of Rawat's role is revealed (L200-L259). A slow rise in trust and joy occurs as allies are revealed and the truth is shared (L260-L363), culminating in a final moment of emotional resolution and familial bond (L357-L363).

While the core plot is universal, the dialogue structure and on-screen text require significant transcreation to match Telugu audience expectations for rhythm, confrontation, and familial dynamics.

transcreations.target_text: స్నో విన్యాసం నుండి ఒక గ్రాండ్ క్లోక్ స్ట్రైక్ చేసింది. ఇషా సుమారు ఒక స్టేట్ కు ప్రస్తావించింది.
transcreations.back_translation: Snow against the windows. A grandfather clock strikes eleven. ISHA (28) drags a suitcase across the marble floor.

transcreations.source_text: I came here to tell you, not to take anything. I just didn't know how.

elements.text: EPISODE 1: Room 214
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, LOBBY - NIGHT
Snow against the windows. A grandfather clock strikes eleven. ISHA (28) drags a suitcase across the marble floor. The front desk is empty.
Hello? Anyone?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: KABIR (31), the hotel manager, steps out of the back office. He freezes when he sees her.
Isha.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Ten years, Kabir. You could at least say welcome home.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Welcome home. I'm sorry it took a funeral.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Where did he die?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Room 214. The doctor said it was his heart.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Dad climbed Jakhu hill every morning. His heart was fine.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Kabir looks away. Behind him, the clock ticks.
Get some sleep. The will is read tomorrow.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: INT. PINECREST HOTEL, DINING HALL - DAY
A long table, cold tea. MAYA (52), Isha's stepmother, in white silk. NIKHIL (25), Isha's half-brother, bouncing his knee. Kabir stands by the door with a sealed envelope.
Mr. Sood made me executor. I'll keep it short.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: He opens the envelope and reads.
"The Pinecrest Hotel, with its land and buildings, goes to my daughter Isha."
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: All of it? I'm his son too!
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: Nikhil. Sit down.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: She left! She didn't even call him on his birthday!
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: I didn't ask for this.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Then don't keep it. A Chandigarh developer offered sixty crore. Sign it to me, and we split it three ways.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Dad turned down every developer for thirty years.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Your father isn't here, Isha. We are.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Maya leaves. Nikhil follows and slams the door.
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, ROOM 214 - NIGHT
Dad's reading glasses are still on the desk. His shawl is folded on the bed. Isha sits in his chair and finally lets herself cry.
She runs her fingers along his bookshelf. One book is too light. She opens it. It is hollow.
Inside is a folded page in her father's handwriting.
ON SCREEN: Note in Dad's handwriting: "Isha, if I die suddenly, it was not my heart. Trust no one at the Pinecrest. Not even K."
(whispering) K...
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: A knock at the door. Three soft taps.
Isha? Are you awake? I need to tell you something.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Isha looks from the door to the note. Not even K.
EPISODE 2: The Offer
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, LOBBY - MORNING
Isha comes down with dark circles under her eyes. Kabir waits at the desk.
You didn't open the door last night.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: I was asleep. What did you want to tell me?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: (hesitating) Only that the staff is with you. Whatever you decide.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: That's it?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: That's it.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: She doesn't believe him. The front doors open. Cold air. INSPECTOR RAWAT (45), polished boots, warm smile, takes off his cap.
Miss Sood. My condolences. Your father was a friend to the whole district.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: Inspector. I want a post-mortem.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: (gently) The cremation was done the same evening, beta. There is nothing left to examine.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: The same evening? Who signed for that?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Your stepmother. She wanted to avoid a scandal before the tourist season.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: He died of a heart attack. Where is the scandal in that?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Rawat smiles and puts his cap back on.
Grief makes us see ghosts. I'll close the file today. Call me if you need anything.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: INT. PINECREST HOTEL, MAYA'S SUITE - DAY
Maya applies lipstick at a mirror. Isha storms in.
You cremated him before anyone could look at him.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: I said goodbye to my husband the way our family always has.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: In six hours?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Rawat said a post-mortem would bring reporters. Reporters would kill the sale.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: So it's about the sale.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: It's about survival. Your father left debts you know nothing about. The offer expires on Friday.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: INT. PINECREST HOTEL, BAR - NIGHT
Nikhil slumps over the counter, refreshing a betting app. Isha sits beside him.
Come to gloat?
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: Where were you the night Dad died?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: In my room. Why?
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: Who do you owe money to?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Nikhil turns his phone face down.
Nobody you need to know.
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: INT. PINECREST HOTEL, SECURITY ROOM - NIGHT
Isha scrolls through the CCTV archive. Every camera, every night. Except one.
ON SCREEN: Corridor 2 camera, 14 November: "Footage deleted 03:12. User: KABIR."
Isha stares at the screen. Behind her, the door creaks open.
EPISODE 3: The Footage
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, SECURITY ROOM - CONTINUOUS
Kabir stands in the doorway.
I can explain.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: You deleted the corridor footage from the night my father died. Explain that.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: It showed Nikhil. Outside Room 214. At two in the morning.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Nikhil?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Your father loved that boy. If the police saw it, they'd pin it on him. So I deleted it.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: You had no right.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Your father asked me to protect this family. I did what I thought he'd want.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Dad left a note, Kabir. It says not to trust K.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Kabir's face goes pale.
And you think K is me.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Give me one reason it isn't.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: I can't. I can only tell you I loved him too.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: INT. PINECREST HOTEL, NIKHIL'S ROOM - NIGHT
Nikhil throws clothes into a bag. Isha blocks the door.
You were outside his room at two in the morning.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: (cracking) I went to beg him for money. I owe fifteen lakh to some men in Chandigarh.
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: Did you go in?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: No! I heard him talking to someone. A man. Calm voice. Deep. They were arguing about papers.
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: Who was it?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: I don't know. I got scared and left. In the morning... he was gone.
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: Does your mother know about the money?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: She knows I owe something. She doesn't know how much.
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: He sits on the bed and sobs. After a moment, Isha sits beside him.
Don't run. Running makes you look guilty.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: INT. PINECREST HOTEL, BACK OFFICE - NIGHT
Past midnight. A thin light under the office door. Isha pushes it open.
ZOYA (24), the new receptionist, is photographing pages of the old land ledger with her phone. She spins around.
Zoya? What are you doing with my father's ledger?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Please close the door.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: I'm calling the police.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Don't. Not the police. Please.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: Isha hesitates, her thumb over the call button.
I'm not a receptionist, Isha. And I'm the reason your father is dead.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: EPISODE 4: The Source
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, BACK OFFICE - CONTINUOUS
I'm a reporter. I write for a news site in Delhi. Your father was my source.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: Source for what?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: The forest land around this hotel. Someone has been forging old land records and selling protected forest to builders.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: And Dad found out.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: He found the original registers. They prove the forgery. He agreed to give them to me on the fifteenth of November.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: He died on the fourteenth.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: (quietly) I pushed him to talk. If I hadn't, he'd still be alive.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: Isha sinks into a chair.
Where are the registers now?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: That's what I've been looking for. These pages are copies. The originals are hidden somewhere in this hotel.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: Why should I trust you?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Zoya shows her a chat on her phone.
ON SCREEN: Message from Vijay Sood, 13 November: "Zoya, come on the 15th. I'll bring everything. Tell no one, not even the police."
Not even the police...
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: He was scared of someone in uniform. He never said who.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: INT. PINECREST HOTEL, KITCHEN - NIGHT
Kabir grates ginger into a pan of boiling tea. Isha watches him from the doorway.
Your father's recipe. Ginger, two cardamoms, no sugar. He drank it every night at eleven.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Who else knew that?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Everyone who ever sat with him. Half of Shimla.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: He pours her a cup. She doesn't drink it.
You still don't trust me.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: I don't trust anyone in this hotel. Dad told me not to.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: INT. PINECREST HOTEL, LOBBY - DAY
Morning. Guests check out. Inspector Rawat walks in with two constables. His smile is gone.
Miss Sood. You wanted a post-mortem. You were right.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: What?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: The hospital kept a blood sample from your father. The lab report came this morning. Poison.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: Maya, coming down the stairs, grips the railing.
Poison? In this house?
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: We searched the staff lockers an hour ago.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: He holds up a small brown bottle in an evidence bag.
This was in your manager's locker. Kabir's.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: Kabir steps out of the office. The constables take his arms.
Isha, I didn't. You know I didn't.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Isha looks at him. The note burns in her pocket. Not even K.
Kabir, you are under arrest for the murder of Vijay Sood.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: EPISODE 5: The Clock
INT. SHIMLA POLICE STATION, LOCKUP - DAY
Kabir sits on a steel bench, his lip split. Isha stands outside the bars.
Did they hit you?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: It doesn't matter. Listen to me. I didn't just delete the footage.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: What do you mean?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: I copied it first. To a pen drive. In case Nikhil ever needed proof he didn't go inside.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Did you watch it?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Only the minute with Nikhil. Then I panicked and deleted the rest.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Where is the pen drive?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Inside the grandfather clock in the lobby. Behind the pendulum.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Why didn't you tell me before?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Because you looked at me like I killed him.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: A constable rattles his keys at the end of the corridor.
(low) And Isha... don't tell Rawat about the pen drive.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Why not?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Because I never kept anything in my locker. Somebody put that bottle there.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: INT. SHIMLA POLICE STATION, CORRIDOR - DAY
Isha walks out. Rawat leans against the wall, sipping tea from a steel glass.
Visiting a murderer, Miss Sood?
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: Visiting a friend.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Your father said the same thing about people. It never ended well for him.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: What did he say about you?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: (smiling) That I was the only man in Shimla he trusted.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: INT. PINECREST HOTEL, LOBBY - NIGHT
The lobby is empty. Isha opens the glass door of the grandfather clock and reaches behind the pendulum.
Dust. Cobwebs. Nothing else. The pen drive is gone.
(to herself) Who else knew?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Zoya comes in with two cups of tea.
Found it?
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: Someone got here first.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Then someone is listening to everything we say.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: INT. PINECREST HOTEL, UPSTAIRS CORRIDOR - NIGHT
Isha walks back to her room. Maya's door is open a crack. Maya is on the phone, low and tense.
(on phone) I told you. She'll sign by Friday.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: (beat)
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: (on phone) And if she doesn't, she ends up like him. I know. I know!
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Isha presses herself against the wall, her hand over her mouth.
EPISODE 6: Friday
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, MAYA'S SUITE - NIGHT
Isha walks in without knocking. Maya drops her phone.
She ends up like him. That's me, isn't it?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: You were listening at my door?
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Who were you talking to?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: The men Nikhil owes money to. They called me, not you.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: And "ends up like him"?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Those were their words, Isha! Not mine. They want the hotel sold so I can pay them. Or they hurt my son.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Why didn't you go to the police?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: I did. I went to Rawat the day your father died.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: And?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: He said a post-mortem would scare the buyer. Cremate quickly, he said, and the debts go away.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Isha goes very still.
Rawat told you to cremate him?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: He was only trying to help.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Or he was making sure nobody tested Dad's blood.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Maya sits down slowly on the bed.
Then why would he test it now?
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: To put it on Kabir.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: For the first time, Maya looks frightened of something other than money.
Where is Nikhil?
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: INT. PINECREST HOTEL, NIKHIL'S ROOM - NIGHT
The room is empty. The window is open. Snow blows in. Nikhil's phone lies on the floor, its screen cracked.
Nikhil? Nikhil!
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: He was here an hour ago. I heard his music.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Isha picks up the phone. It buzzes in her hand.
ON SCREEN: Message from unknown number: "Your brother is with us. Sign the sale papers by Friday noon. No police."
A photo loads below it. Nikhil, tied to a chair, a bruise on his cheek.
Maya screams.
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, LOBBY - NIGHT
Zoya is at the front desk. Isha and Maya rush down the stairs.
What happened?
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: They took Nikhil.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Who?
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: Isha's phone buzzes again.
ON SCREEN: Unknown number: "Tell the reporter girl to stay out of it. We know who she is."
EPISODE 7: The Badge
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, DINING HALL - DAY
Isha signs a stack of sale papers. Maya watches, hollow-eyed. Zoya paces.
If you sign, the forest is gone. Everything your father died for.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: My brother is tied to a chair, Zoya.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Your father would want you to fight.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: My father is dead. Nikhil isn't. Not yet.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: She signs the last page.
(quietly) Thank you.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Isha's phone buzzes.
ON SCREEN: Unknown number: "Old toll naka on the Kufri road. Noon. Bring the papers."
At least take the police.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: They said no police.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: The doors open. Inspector Rawat walks in, cap under his arm.
Miss Sood. I heard about your brother. Mrs. Sood called me.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: Isha looks at Maya. Maya nods.
I'll come with you. Plain clothes. Nobody will know.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: (hesitating) Thank you, Inspector.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: INT. ISHA'S CAR, KUFRI ROAD - DAY
Rawat drives. Pine trees blur past. Isha holds the papers on her lap.
Your father and I were in school together. He was the clever one. I was the one who got caught.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: And now you catch people.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Somebody has to. Don't worry, beta. In an hour, your brother will be home.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: How can you be so sure?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Because these men want money, not blood. I know the type.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: EXT. OLD TOLL NAKA, KUFRI ROAD - DAY
Fog. An abandoned toll booth. A black SUV waits. Isha walks forward with the papers. Rawat stays by her car.
The SUV's back door opens. Nikhil stumbles out and runs to her. She holds him tight.
Didi... I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: You're safe. That's all that matters.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: A gloved hand takes the papers through the SUV window. The SUV drives off into the fog.
Rawat walks up and puts a hand on Nikhil's shoulder.
It's over now. Go home and rest.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: His wallet slips from his jacket and falls open on the road. Isha sees his police ID card.
ON SCREEN: Police ID card: "Inspector Karan Rawat, Shimla Police."
Isha stops breathing.
(whispering) Karan. K.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Rawat picks up the wallet and smiles at her.
Something wrong, Miss Sood?
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: Nothing. Just cold.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: EPISODE 8: The Voice
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, ISHA'S ROOM - NIGHT
Isha, Zoya, Maya and Nikhil sit on the floor around Dad's note.
Not even K. Not Kabir. Karan. Karan Rawat.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Rawat has eaten at our table for twenty years.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Who better to steal forest records than the man who guards them?
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: (slowly) At the toll naka. When he said "it's over now"...
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: What?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: The voice in Dad's room that night. Calm. Deep. It was the same voice.
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: Silence.
There's something else. The pen drive in the clock. I took it.
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: You?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: I saw Kabir hide something in the clock the morning Dad died.
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: He swallows hard.
I thought it would show me outside the room. I was scared, Didi. I haven't even watched it.
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: He pulls it out of his sock and puts it in her palm.
If Rawat is on that footage, it's over for him.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: Then he will come for it.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Then we let him think we don't have it. Nobody says a word outside this room.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Maya takes Isha's hand. It's the first time she has ever done it.
I was wrong about you.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: I was wrong about you too.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: I'll call my editor. If anything happens to us, the story still runs.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: Then call her now.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Zoya steps onto the balcony, phone to her ear. Snow settles on her hair.
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, LOBBY - NIGHT
Isha carries a laptop downstairs to play the pen drive. Halfway down, she smells smoke.
Fire! The archive room!
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: Thick black smoke pours from under the archive room door. The fire alarm shrieks.
The old registers might be in there!
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: That's what he wants. He's burning the proof.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: A figure runs in from the front door, coat pulled over his head. It is Kabir.
Kabir? They let you out?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Bail, this evening. Rawat signed it himself.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: He kicks the archive door open and disappears into the fire.
EPISODE 9: Smoke
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, ARCHIVE ROOM - NIGHT
Flames climb the wooden shelves. Kabir pulls a steel trunk from under a desk, coughing.
Kabir! Get out!
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Not without this!
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: He drags the trunk out as a burning shelf collapses behind him.
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, LOBBY - NIGHT
Staff throw buckets of water and snow. Fire engine sirens outside. Kabir sits on the floor, his palms red and blistered. Zoya opens the trunk.
Inside are thick, singed land registers, wrapped in plastic.
These are the originals. Look. The forest survey numbers. Your father's notes in the margin.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: (to Kabir) You could have died.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: He gave me a home when I had nowhere to go. I owed him one fire.
elements.speaker: KABIR

elements.text: Isha presses a cold towel into his hands. She holds them a moment too long. Neither of them pulls away.
Inspector Rawat walks in from the cold with the firemen, every inch the concerned officer.
Is everyone safe? An electrical short, they're saying. These old buildings.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: (under her breath) Electrical. Of course.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: I'll need those registers for the inquiry. Evidence.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: (stepping in front of the trunk) They're wet, Inspector. Let them dry. You can take them in the morning.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Rawat holds her gaze, then smiles.
In the morning, then.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: He walks out. Maya turns to Nikhil.
Sit on that trunk. Nobody touches it. Not even the firemen.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Mom, I'm not a child.
elements.speaker: NIKHIL

elements.text: Then for once, act like the son of Vijay Sood.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: Nikhil sits on the trunk. He doesn't move again.
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, BACK OFFICE - NIGHT
Three in the morning. Isha plugs the pen drive into the laptop. Alone. She clicks play.
ON SCREEN: CCTV, Corridor 2, 14 November, 01:58: A man in a police coat knocks on Room 214, carrying a steel thermos.
The man turns toward the camera. Inspector Rawat.
ON SCREEN: CCTV, 02:40: Rawat leaves Room 214, wiping the thermos with a handkerchief.
Isha covers her mouth.
A floorboard creaks behind her. A calm, deep voice.
You shouldn't have watched that, Isha.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: EPISODE 10: Not Even K
INT. PINECREST HOTEL, BACK OFFICE - CONTINUOUS
Rawat stands in the doorway, his service pistol in his hand. Calm. Almost sad.
Close the laptop. Slowly.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: Isha closes it. Her phone lies face down beside it.
Why? He called you a friend.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: He was a friend. Then he found a few old registers and became a saint.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: You poisoned him.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: I made him tea. Ginger, the way he liked it. He drank it while telling me he was going to the press.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: And Kabir's locker?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: A case needs someone to blame. Kabir was convenient. So was your stepmother's fear.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: And the fire?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Old wiring.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: He steps closer.
Now give me the pen drive. Or this hotel has another heart attack.
elements.speaker: RAWAT

elements.text: Isha slides the pen drive across the desk.
Take it. It's a copy.
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: Rawat's eyes flick to her phone. She turns it over. A live call to Zoya. Recording.
(from the phone) Every word, Inspector. And the SP heard all of it.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: Rawat raises the gun. Kabir crashes through the side door and slams into him. The gun skids across the floor. Nikhil kicks it away.
Blue lights flood the windows. Maya walks in with the SP and four officers.
Your file is closed, Inspector.
elements.speaker: MAYA

elements.text: The officers cuff Rawat and lead him out into the snow.
EXT. PINECREST HOTEL, GARDEN - DAWN
The snow has stopped. Smoke still curls from the archive window. Isha stands with Kabir, Maya and Nikhil. Zoya walks up with a singed envelope.
This was inside the steel trunk. It's addressed to you.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: Isha opens it. A second will, dated 13 November.
ON SCREEN: Will in Dad's handwriting: "Half of the Pinecrest goes to Isha. The other half goes to my daughter, Zoya."
Isha looks up slowly.
Your daughter?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: I came here to tell you, not to take anything. I just didn't know how.
elements.speaker: ZOYA

elements.text: You're... my sister?
elements.speaker: ISHA

elements.text: He found me six months ago. I'm not just his source, Isha. I'm his daughter.
elements.speaker: ZOYA
